correctness.rationale: The Cauchy area formula converts estimator/S(K) into the average of F_w(u)=2 Σ_i w_i|v_i·u|. Oppositely oriented thin slabs show spherical extrema are sharp. F_w is the support function of the four-generator zonotope. The six facet-normal minima give m=2√(2/3)(w_(1)+w_(2)); the 16 signed-vertex sums with tetrahedral Gram matrix give M=4/√3 sqrt(Σw_i²−δ²/4). Since the two smallest weights sum at most 1/2, uniquely at uniform weights, the claimed minimax value 1−√(2/3) follows. Exact vertex/facet identities in the inspected source checker corroborate these operations; geometric proof supplies all-body quantifiers.
